nigeria_market_note: Nigeria’s parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations dated 2 Nov (one updated 04:00 WAT and one with time not shown), rechecked at 13:36 WAT. The full observed ranges are preserved rather than forcing a single quote. CBN benchmark rates are those of 30 Oct, the latest posted. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
parallel_source: Aggregated from multiple independent market sources
official_sources: Central Bank of Nigeria and national official reference tables
